verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official DeepInfra CLI. The evidence covers OpenAI-SDK compatibility, an OpenAI spec, a Swagger UI and SSH access to rented GPU clusters. These are SDK and API surfaces or host-level access, not a first-party command-line tool, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
